2610.06643.title: AffordCraft: Scalable Construction of Task-Ready Simulation Assets from Single Images
2610.06643.paper_summary: Robot learning in simulation depends on the objects the simulator offers. Many tasks need objects with separate parts, joints that allow the required motion, and physical properties that remain valid under contact. Existing methods recover this structure anew for every image: generative models predict parts and joints that mostly fail to settle or move in simulation, and general-purpose agents need a long session of model calls for each photograph. AffordCraft builds such an asset from a single RGB image and a task instruction by retrieval instead of generation: it locates the object and the part to operate, selects a matching entry from a library of articulated assets, and fits it to the image while keeping its parts and joints intact. Without any box or mask marking the object, AffordCraft produces a physically valid asset for 1,703 of 2,000 photographs from 31 categories. Five generative methods pass on at most 45% of the same photographs and, at the median, need 10 to 78 times our GPU time per valid asset. On 50 cluttered images, 162 of 237 annotated objects pass the same physical test after automatic detection. Growing the library from 141 to 11,372 entries needs no change to the method and raises category coverage from 46% to 100% and the share of selections with the requested label from 18% to 51%. We also build manipulation tasks from the constructed assets, both with single objects and in composed scenes; policies trained on scripted demonstrations complete both kinds of tasks from initial states unseen in training.
2610.06643.paper_summary_zh: 機器人在模擬中的學習依賴於模擬器提供的物件。許多任務需要具有獨立部件、允許所需運動的關節以及在接觸下仍然有效的物理特性。現有的方法對每張圖像重新恢復這種結構：生成模型預測的部件和關節大多無法在模擬中穩定或移動，而通用代理需要對每張照片進行長時間的模型調用。AffordCraft通過檢索而非生成，從單一的RGB圖像和任務指令構建這樣的資產：它定位要操作的物件和部件，從關節資產的庫中選擇匹配的條目，並在保持其部件和關節完整的同時將其適配到圖像中。AffordCraft在沒有任何框或標記物件的面具下，為2,000張來自31個類別的照片中的1,703張生成了物理有效的資產。五種生成方法最多僅通過45%的相同照片，並且在中位數上，每個有效資產需要10到78倍於我們的GPU時間。在50張雜亂的圖像中，自動檢測後237個標註物件中有162個通過了相同的物理測試。將庫從141個條目擴展到11,372個條目不需要改變方法，並將類別覆蓋率從46%提高到100%，以及帶有請求標籤的選擇比例從18%提高到51%。我們還從構建的資產中建立操作任務，無論是單個物件還是組合場景；在腳本演示上訓練的策略能夠完成兩種任務，從訓練中未見的初始狀態開始。
